occupancy.title: Occupancy schedule
occupancy.description:
A 24×7 grid of hourly slots, learned from motion sensors and editable by hand on the Lovelace card. The controller runs one action when somebody is expected and another when nobody is.

{summary}

occupancy_sensors.title: Motion sensors & preheat
occupancy_sensors.description:
Learning starts as soon as motion sensors are selected — the toggle only decides whether the schedule is allowed to switch the controller. Watch the grid fill in for a week first if you like.

Preheat is how early the expected state starts, so underfloor heating has time to make the floor warm before anyone arrives.

data.enabled: Let the schedule control the climate entity
data.motion_hold_minutes: Hold the expected state after motion (minutes)
data._back: ← Cancel (don't save changes on this screen)

occupancy_learning.title: Learning window & threshold
occupancy_learning.description: Each slot is observed once a week. Its score is the share of the recent weeks in which motion was seen — 2 of the last 4 Mondays at 13:00 is 0.5. Slots at or above the threshold turn blue and drive the schedule; slots that saw motion but stayed below it are shown grey.

data.learning_min_days: Ignore learned slots until this many days have been observed
data._back: ← Cancel (don't save changes on this screen)

occupancy_actions.title: Actions per state
occupancy_actions.description: Applied once on each transition, so a manual change made in between is left alone until the next one.

data._back: ← Cancel (don't save changes on this screen)

occupancy_maintenance.title: Clear / reset the grid
occupancy_maintenance.description: Both act immediately — they change stored history, not the draft this flow saves on exit.

data.reset_learning: Forget the learned history (keeps manual cells)

options.min: Minimum — heat until the coldest room is satisfied
options.max: Maximum — stop when the warmest room is satisfied
options.median: Median — ignores a single outlying sensor
